scope: Source review and derived capacity requirements only; no RTL p4, bandwidth, physical timing or rate qualification

buffer_requirements.required_resolution: A larger production allocation or explicitly scheduled slot reuse/streaming; the AR stage buffer is insufficient evidence

attention_tile.mask_obligation: The broadcast operand pad is shared across query/head lanes. Overall tail padding cannot replace each query's causal valid length. QK-norm remains FP32 into RoPE; Q rounds BF16 after RoPE, K rounds FP8 at append.

kvs.padding_drop: bj >= nsec is suppressed; nsec is a common per-PC sector limit, not a query-specific token-row bound
kvs.tail_sector_obligation: With simple continuous four-stack/32-PC sector striping, 12 PCs per stack need one extra sector. An actual bank-aware Qwen mapping and partial-sector/row masks must prove this; a padded uniform stream needs downstream validity and allocated padding.
kvs.position_width_obligation: Retain full query/cache position in address and owner metadata; the 10-bit transport tag is not a global row index

production_su.quarter_scope: Physical envelope around 192 light lanes; lane input rotations and XOR output merge. Generator explicitly states controller and die-port protocol are not built.
production_su.parent_scope: N1024/M256 source-bound minimum HCpost binder accepts only four exact ORIGINAL_0..3 program words; it does not accept these Qwen kernels

measured_stage_limit: Committed N64/M16 c12 DPI stage passes cover isolated AR mathematical tensors. They do not establish p4 capacity, causal masking, rollback, production quarter dispatch, clock closure or rate.
